x. It can help you:</p><ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Write code</strong>: Describe what you want to build, and Codex =
generates code that matches your intent, adapting to your existing project =
structure and conventions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Understand unfamiliar codebases</strong>: Codex can read and exp=
lain complex or legacy code, helping you grasp how teams organize systems.<=
/p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Review code</strong>: Codex analyzes code to identify potential =
bugs, logic errors, and unhandled edge cases.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Debug and fix problems</strong>: When something breaks, Codex he=
lps trace failures, diagnose root causes, and suggest targeted fixes.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Automate development tasks</strong>: Codex can run repetitive wo=
rkflows such as refactoring, testing, migrations, and setup tasks so you ca=
n focus on higher-level engineering work.</p>
</li>
